prohibited_shortcut: TPP and numerical equality do not imply injectivity of the global multiplication map.

claims.statement: For a finite 2-group R of order 2 n^2 with a center-free cyclic subgroup of order n>=8, exactly one nonzero class of R/Frattini(R) supports a center-free cyclic generator of order greater than four.
claims.scope: Uniform under the displayed hypotheses; retained marked isobicyclic classification.

claims.statement: If P=<a,b> has order 4 n^2 with n>=16, |a|=|b|=n and both cyclic subgroups avoid Z(P), their involutions centralize their respective maximal subgroups, the center is cyclic, there is a normal E8 in Z(Frattini(P)) with centralizer Frattini(P), and Frattini(P) is nonabelian.
claims.scope: Necessary restrictions on the smallest-factor-eight boundary; no full exclusion or classification.

claims.statement: SmallGroup(32,5) has a cyclic subgroup TPP triple of orders 2,8,2 whose product set has size 24 although the factor-order product equals 32.
claims.scope: One exact counterexample to a tempting stronger inference, not to cyclic TPP.

primary_classification: Du-Jones-Kwak-Nedela-Skoviera arXiv:1112.2376v1, Theorem 4.1 and Lemma 2.1, plus 2007 metacyclic Theorem 1.1(1); exact retained source scope is in phase10_cyclic_tpp_certificate.json. No third-party full text included.

computation.prerequisites: Python 3 standard library with frozen phase10 coordinate module; GAP with SmallGrp for the single witness.
computation.proof_boundary: Bounded normal-form diagnostics only. No catalogue at order 1024 was searched. No complete gamma-eight exclusion is claimed.
